purchaseOrders.title: Purchase orders
purchaseOrders.subtitle: Supplier quotes compared, the order drafted by the buyer and issued by another approver, then received
purchaseOrders.noCompany: No company yet. Admin adds companies on Admin → Companies.
purchaseOrders.noRight: You don't have the right to see purchase orders. Ask Admin.

err.gstin: Choose the GSTIN the order is from.
err.line: Line {{n}}: choose the item and give a quantity (up to 3 decimals) and a rate.

list.title: Orders
list.emptyBody: Approve a request, ask suppliers for quotes and choose one; or start a new order.

editor.keyboard: Enter on the last rate adds a line. Tax is worked out by the server from the HSN table.
editor.saved: Draft saved. Total ₹{{total}} as the server worked it out.
editor.savedFlags: {{n}} lines are dearer than the last purchase.
editor.flagsTitle: {{n}} lines are dearer than the last purchase
editor.waitIssuer: Waiting for an approver to issue it.
editor.issueRule: The person who drafted an order cannot issue it. Issuing takes the order number, records the rates and queues the order to the supplier on WhatsApp (only to a consented number).
editor.confirmEffect: Issues the order to {{supplier}} for ₹{{total}}, takes the next order number and queues it on WhatsApp for the supplier.

view.title: Purchase order {{no}}
view.cancelBody: Only an order with nothing received can be cancelled. A queued WhatsApp message is cancelled too.
view.waQueued: The order is queued on WhatsApp for the supplier. Sending starts once the WhatsApp Business account is connected.
view.waSkipped: Not sent on WhatsApp: the supplier has no consented WhatsApp number. Send the order another way.

rfq.noApproved: No approved request is waiting. Requests are approved on Purchase requests.
rfq.noSuppliers: No suppliers for this company yet. Add them on Suppliers.
rfq.emptyBody: Choose an approved request and the suppliers to ask.
rfq.compareTitle: Quotations side by side · net rate before GST
rfq.chooseBody: The other quotations are marked not chosen, the RFQ closes and a draft purchase order is made from these rates. Another approver issues it.
